name: Claude Workspace
description: Installs the pinned claude-workspace CLI and, when the container is created, installs Claude Code and the workspace into the project folder.

source.description: Where the workspace CLI comes from: 'bundled' (the copy packaged with this feature) or an npx spec such as github:<owner>/<repo>#v0.7.4

marketplace.description: Marketplace source written to the project's .claude/settings.json (e.g. <owner>/<repo>#v0.7.4). Empty: the CLI's own copy inside the container (works, but that path is container-only).

installClaudeCode.description: Install Claude Code with the native installer when 'claude' is not on PATH

claudeCodeVersion.description: 'tested' (the version the workspace lock was tested with), 'latest', or an exact version

installOnCreate.description: Run 'claude-workspace install' on the workspace folder after the container is created. False: only the CLI is installed.
